title: 图像传送带：看参考板—举篮—本地速度跟踪截获—放入举起的篮子
phases: Read the displayed reference image in the current RGB, record the semantic target and distinguish it from conveyor distractors. This is not the remember-first-object task.
Pick and lift basket with the non-intercepting hand by >8cm; keep it raised through final containment rather than putting it back down to home.

Identify the matching live conveyor object and a support feature on the belt. intercept measures current shape and three-frame optical flow locally, then invokes a timestamped timed_pick without GPT between tracking and closing.
Inspect actual retention on fresh wrist/head RGB; after capture use place(mode=inside) with fresh basket support feature measured at its CURRENT lifted height.
Inspect target inside raised basket. Finish preserving basket grip; the task does not require home.
failure_lesson: The moving object leaves a stale grasp point before closure. Native TCP lift does not establish object capture. Never perform unrelated motion between measured velocity and timed_pick.
reference_success_scope: External aggregates have native successes; transfer timing must be reproduced, not inferred from static grasp macros.
